title: Create a channel group
description:
Free. Creates a channel group — a separate set of connected social accounts
(e.g. "English channels") — and provisions its publishing profile. The group
number is never reused. ⚠ Running consumes provider profile quota; 409
`profile_limit_reached` when the plan is full.

use_cases.title: ➕ Create a channel group
use_cases.description: Give the group a name. Then connect its platforms at widecast.ai/#setup → Connect Social Account → pick the group tab. ⚠ Run provisions a provider profile.
